items.q: My mother's father's name was Isadore John Barbarin. His wife, his maiden name was Josephine Auphidore(?)

ctx.x: Well, what was your mother's parent's name?

My mother's father's name was Isadore John Barbarin. His wife, his maiden name was Josephine Auphidore(?). Her grandmother's mother had came from Haiti. She spoke French, she spoke Creole, she spoke Patois and Cajol(?). All of them is different versions of the French, all of them spoke by different people. French was spoken by the Whites.
